# `compat/healers/asset-healer.js`

> **Source:** `engine/compat/healers/asset-healer.js`

healers/asset-healer.js — resolve bundled relative asset references. A multi-file guest references `<img src="logo.png">`, `<source src="clip.webm">`, etc. Those relative URLs won't resolve inside the realm, so this pass rewrites any reference present in the package `files` map to a blob URL. The created URLs are recorded on `model._assetBlobs` so the realm revokes them on destroy.
